Overview

The AeroBook 14 pairs a 2.8K OLED panel with Intel's Core Ultra 7 processor in an aluminum chassis that weighs just 1.4 kg. All-day battery life, a quiet fan curve and a full-size HDMI port make it an easy pick for work and travel.
